items.title: Solutions Engineering Manager
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. About the role: We're looking for a Solutions Engineering Manager to lead and grow our presales function in NYC. Reporting to our presales VP of Solutions Engineering, this is a founding leadership role where you'll help us establish the discipline from the ground up, shaping the playbook that drives your region's success while collaborating across the business to share best practices. As a Solutions Engineering Manager, you will have full ownership of your team's success; you'll be hiring and developing Solutions Engineers, while staying hands-on in the highest-impact deals in your market. You'll set the bar for how your team runs discovery, demos, Proofs of Concept, and technical evaluations. You'll regularly partner with Sales leadership, Product, Customer Success, and Product Marketing to connect your team's work to revenue outcomes. You'll own forecasting, performance, and the overall health of your market, collaborating with presales leadership on strategy and priorities. Recruitment and Development - Hire, ramp, and develop a team of 5-10 Solutions Engineers (SEs)in your region, across experience levels, from mid-career to subject matter experts. - Run regular 1:1s, deal reviews, and career development conversations, ensuring a high quality of discovery, demos, and technical evaluations across the team. - Build a collaborative, inclusive team culture where Solutions Engineers support each other across deals, not just their own book. Execution - Execute and reinforce Synthesia's core presales motions (research, discovery, demos, workshops, Proofs of Concept, champion building, and handover to customer success) with consistency across your team. - Design and evolve Synthesia's demo methodology across Studio, Roleplay Sessions, and Interactive Avatars, so your team proves business value quickly regardless of use case. - Build and maintain the presales toolkit for your team with Synthesia's product and operations teams for demo environments, reusable assets, evaluation guides, and objection handling; iterating where you see gaps for your market. - Evangelize and drive consistent use of AI tools across your team, from call prep to demo delivery to turning discovery notes into follow-up documentation to improve win rate and deal size. - Partner with Enablement and senior SEs in other markets to share what's working and avoid rebuilding the same assets twice. - Own forecasting and pipeline hygiene for presales involvement in your market, and report on team performance, win rates, and Proofs of Concept throughput to presales leadership. - Partner with Sales leadership on account and territory strategy, resourcing your team against the highest-value opportunities. - Bring visibility to deal risk, timeline, and technical dependencies across your team's active opportunities, and unblock what your SEs can't unblock alone. - Route field feedback, product gaps, and competitive intelligence from your team up to Product, Product Marketing, and SE leadership. Domain and Playbook expertise - Design and evolve Synthesia's demo methodology across Studio, Roleplay Sessions, and Interactive Avatars. - Use your experience in expert-level discovery, demonstrations, and Proofs of Concept scoping to coach SEs at every level. - Build fluency in MEDDPICC and Command of the Message frameworks across your team through coaching on real-world application, not framework recitation. - Deliver and coach Proofs of Concept and executive readouts as a business narrative, not a feature tour, holding the room with C-level audiences yourself when the deal calls for it. About you: - Experience recruiting, managing, and developing Solution Engineering presales teams. - You've owned the full employee life cycle from hiring through onboarding and promotions, across tenures from early stage to specialised individual contributors. You've done this with teams you've inherited, plus those you've built from scratch. - Your path to leadership started as an IC executing straightforward opportunities against a playbook, then evolved into solving complex problems with product partners - ultimately building deep expertise in a specific business area or vertical. - Track record of improving team performance through coaching, hands-on deal support, and consistent execution of an established presales process, not through reinventing it. - Comfortable owning forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and performance reporting from a presales perspective, not mimicking the AE perspective. - Fluent in MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, with the credibility to coach both new and experienced SEs on applying them. - Clear, inclusive communicator who can flex from deep technical detail to executive-level value narratives, and can teach others to do the same. - Collaborative leadership style, comfortable partnering with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Product Marketing leadership as peers, not just stakeholders. Location: This role is hybrid (2+ days a week in our NYC office depending on needs), and we offer 60 days "work from anywhere" annually. Beneftis - A competitive salary + stock options in our fast-growing Series E startup - Hybrid working environment for NY based employees - 100% Medical, Dental & Vision - 401k Plan + company match - Paid parental leave - 25 days of annual leave + Public holidays + paid sick leave - Fun culture with regular socials - A generous referral scheme - A brand new computer + monitor, + a working from home stipend

items.title: User Experience Researcher, Platform
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role UX research at Anthropic works across products used by millions of people, on interactions that don't have established conventions yet. We inform critical decisions through rigorous research, working closely with curious, open-minded stakeholders who are eager to learn along with us. We combine qualitative and quantitative methods to understand user needs in a space that's evolving faster than anyone can track. We move fast, favor impact over polish, and increasingly build our own tools, deeply leveraging Claude to do research at the speed and rigor this environment demands. This role is on the Platform research team, embedded in Anthropic's Platform organization, which comprises the API, the agent and connector infrastructure developers build on top of it, and the Console, SDKs, and documentation they use to do it. A large share of what gets built with Claude is built on this platform, including many of Anthropic's own products, and the people who use it range from individual developers to the largest enterprises. The teams that build the platform are deeply technical, move quickly, and are deeply curious about and engaged with users. User research's job here is to give them a deeper and more systematic understanding of those users than they can get on their own, and to help the organization decide what to build for them next. This is a senior individual-contributor role with a great deal of autonomy. You'll work with the rest of the Platform user research team and with Platform's leaders to decide where research can make the biggest difference, and then lead that work yourself. Key responsibilities Work with Platform's leaders and teams to understand what they most need to know about the people building on Claude, decide what is and isn't worth studying, and own that agenda Design and run the research yourself using both qualitative and quantitative methods Study the full range of people the platform serves: developers, the teams and companies building products on it, and the people who administer and buy it Communicate findings to product managers, designers, and engineers and follow them through to product decisions, while building the shared understanding of users that lets teams make good calls on their own Build the tools and infrastructure that let research keep pace with the platform, using Claude heavily and inventing methods where the existing ones don't fit Minimum qualifications Industry UX research experience independently scoping, designing, running, and reporting end-to-end studies Mixed-methods expertise: interviewing technical users well, and designing and analyzing surveys rigorously A technical background, in one of these forms: you've worked as a software engineer; you have a sustained body of developer-experience research on APIs, SDKs, or developer tools; or you have a sustained track record of researching deeply technical products. In practice: you can read our documentation, build something small on the platform, and keep up with very technical teams without translation Hands-on use of AI in your own research: you already run your work through it and use it to build your own analyses and tooling Preferred qualifications 8+ years of industry UX research experience Experience setting the research strategy for a product or product area, with a track record of research that changed direction at the strategy level, not just the feature level, in direct partnership with product or organization leaders Experience embedding with engineering-led product teams that ship fast and earning influence there, from the engineer who owns the endpoint up to the head of the organization Excellent storytelling, calibrated to audience: you can discuss a finding with the head of the organization as effectively as with the engineer who owns the endpoint Experience building with AI yourself using coding tools and agents, and an appetite to help build the research tools that don't exist yet Experience researching pricing, packaging, or how customers decide what a product is worth, especially for usage-based or developer products Background in API-ecosystem or developer-platform research The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $305,000 — $385,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Senior Software Development Team Coordinator
items.location_text: Amphoe Mueang Chiang Mai, Thailand , TH
items.description: The Senior Software Development Team Coordinator (Thailand) is the operational right hand of the Thailand Team Leader within the Sitebuilders Chiang Mai team. This role supports the Team Leader to operate at a strategic and technical level — by owning the people rhythm and day-to-day operational layer of the Thailand hub. The Software Development Team Coordinator reports directly to the Thailand Team Leader and works in close partnership to ensure strong team operations, delivery consistency, and people development across the Thailand hub. This role is not intended to act as a buffer between the Team Leader and the team, but rather as a strong operational partner who increases the effectiveness of both. Success in this role is measured by the health and performance of the team, as well as by the Team Leader’s ability to focus on high-impact strategic and technical responsibilities. Responsibilities People Leadership & Team Development • Serve as the primary people manager for Thailand-based engineers — owning regular 1:1s, feedback cycles, and individual development plans in close coordination with the Team Leader. • Monitor team morale, identify and report risks early, and address interpersonal issues with discretion before they escalate to the Team Leader. • Support engineers' career progression by identifying growth opportunities and skill gaps, aligned with the Team Leader and UXM Architect’s technical direction. • Lead onboarding coordination for new Thailand-based hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the team's ways of working. • Build and reinforce a team culture of ownership, initiative, and continuous improvement — consistent with the Team Leader's vision for the team. Delivery & Operational Coordination • Track Kanban progress across the Thailand team, ensuring blockers are surfaced and resolved without pulling the Team Leader away from technical priorities. • Manage day-to-day task allocation and priority adjustments in fast-switching delivery cycles within a Kanban system. • Compile and deliver structured monthly reports to upper management layers detailing overall team status, KPI metrics, operational delivery risks, and sensitive people or performance issues. Every identified issue, bottleneck, or risk must be accompanied by a concrete, actionable remediation plan to improve and resolve the situation dynamically. • Oversee accurate time logging and estimation integrity across the team (including for the Deputy role itself). Technical Contribution & Stability Support • Assist the Front-End Team Leader in identifying potential personnel or project risks and help formulate contingency plans. • Support the Project Anchors and the Stability Unit by ensuring developers are available and focused during critical production fixes. • Maintain sufficient technical credibility to follow engineering discussions, understand the team’s work, and ask relevant questions. While this role is not the primary technical authority, it is expected to operate confidently and effectively within technical conversations. • Act as a first-level escalation point for day-to-day operational and process questions, resolving escalations before it reaches the Team Leader. • Uphold UXM documentation requirements and Definition of Done compliance within the team. Hiring Support • Participate in hiring panels for Thailand-based frontend roles, providing structured feedback on culture fit, communication, and working style. • Assist in scoping role requirements in coordination with the Team Leader. Requirements Experience: At least 2 years of experience in a people management or team coordination role in a tech team. Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with Front End frameworks and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JS (React, Angular etc.)). We value the ability to translate technical constraints into project timelines, ensuring you can accurately assess scope and complexity during the planning phase. • Genuine people leadership instinct — you find energy in developing others, you notice when someone is struggling before they say it, and you handle sensitive conversations with care. • Organized, dependable, and calm under pressure — the team should feel steadier because you are in the room. • High level of initiative, ownership, and leadership mindset. • Strong communication skills in English; able to represent team dynamics and delivery status clearly to the Team Leader and upward when needed. • iGaming or SaaS platform experience is an advantage. Here's what we offer: · Start with 20 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year (up to 30 days by your fifth year with us), along with 13 public holidays per year. · Enjoy a flexible hybrid work schedule after your first three months with us. · Support for New Parents: - 21 weeks of paid maternity leave, with the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child turns 1 year old. - 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. Benefits & Perks: · Monthly meal allowance · Medical Subscription and Annual Physical/Medical check-up. · Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. · Gym allowance. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference!

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE ROLE As VP of Demand Generation, you will be the CMO's right hand and lead Mistral's global demand generation and field marketing organization. This is a highly strategic leadership role responsible for building a world-class revenue engine that drives enterprise adoption of Mistral's products and solutions. You'll lead a global team spanning Demand Generation, Field Marketing, and ABM, partnering closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Communications, and Revenue Operations. You'll help define how Mistral goes to market, influence company strategy, and build the programs that connect the world's leading organizations with frontier AI.
